explication: rAthena is a C++ MMORPG server package. The principal workflow is a game client connecting through login and character services to a map server, where player actions, NPC scripts, skills, and world systems are processed and persisted. The graph also includes the documented web-facing emblem, merchant-store, and party-booking capabilities. Some service handoffs are inferred from the repository’s service structure rather than shown in sampled excerpts; those links are dashed and uncited.
